summary: Four Front Range climbers (2 men, 2 women) became 'cliffed out' and spent the night on Maroon Peak; a HAATS helicopter evacuated all four to the Maroon Bells parking lot by 8:46 am Thursday; 19 Mountain Rescue Aspen members involved
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen, Colorado Army National Guard HAATS, CareFlight of the Rockies, Pitkin County Sheriff
notes: Called for help Wednesday June 26; rescued Thursday June 27; no injuries; MRA's second high-peaks rescue of the season CBN 2019-08 'busy this summer' roundup: the four climbers (mid-50s to 75) were stuck on the west face of South Maroon Peak; CBMRT handed the call to Aspen Mountain Rescue due to access issues on their side and a helicopter hoist evacuated them. TGR corroboration added run 684: 2M+2F Front Range hikers, cliffed out Maroon Peak, overnight, Guard helo to Maroon Bells lot.
